summary: Iteration 630 / Paket33 BE-gap MVP end-to-end test. Backend fully passes (15/15 pytest cases): BE settings public/put + validation, agent-code case-insensitive validate + 404/422, waitlist add/dup/dates/email + admin list + _notify_waitlist worker (status→notified, email_outbox kind=waitlist with /book?property=default&check_in=2027-04-01 link), reserve-multi with agent_code+flex_cancel+payment_method=hold produces status=hold with hold_expires_at, extra_adults=1, extra_adult_total=140, los_discount_pct=10, agent_discount>0, flex_cancel_fee>0, cancellation_type=free; _expire_holds moves booking to cancelled with cancel_reason=hold_expired; second reserve without addons stays confirmed with zero addon fields; fx-rates count>=30, EUR≈1.13, TRY>30, source=currency_fx. Frontend booking flow works end-to-end: dates search → room select → cart continue → guest step; agent-code-input/apply shows 'ACME Travel — −15%', flex-cancel-checkbox raises total by 8% (£470→£520), payment-hold-option renders 'Hold price for 24h (no payment)', complete-booking-btn label becomes 'Hold this price', submission creates a confirmed booking-ref (MHB-090D14D3) which in Mongo is correctly stored with status='hold', payment_method='hold', hold_expires_at set. Currency selector switches to EUR with window.__fxSource==='currency_fx'.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='summary-los' is not rendered on a 7-night stay even though backend applies 10% LOS discount (£62.6). Line 'Long-stay discount −10%' is missing from the cart summary.

data-testid='summary-agent' is not rendered after successfully applying ACME2026 (agent-code-applied does show 'ACME Travel — −15%' correctly, but the summary line for the agent discount amount does not appear).
data-testid='summary-flex' is not rendered after ticking flex-cancel-checkbox, although the total does update (+8%).

For a payment_method='hold' booking the confirmation page shows 'Booking Confirmed! Your reservation is confirmed'. Backend correctly stores status='hold' with hold_expires_at, so the UI copy should reflect a HOLD state (e.g. 'Price on hold — expires in 24h') and include the expiry countdown, otherwise guests will think they've paid.

action_items: Render <div data-testid='summary-los'> when nights>=7 (or whenever beCfg los_tiers matches) with '−{pct}%' text and amount.
Render <div data-testid='summary-agent'> line when agent_code is applied, showing '−{agent.discount_pct}%' and the calculated amount.
Render <div data-testid='summary-flex'> line when flex_cancel is enabled with '+{flex_cancel_pct}%' and calculated fee.
Update the confirmation step so that hold bookings display 'Price on hold' copy with expiry timer instead of 'Booking Confirmed!'.
critical_code_review_comments: workers.py is >1500 lines and mixes many unrelated cron loops (social, revenue, distribution, killswitch, BE holds/waitlist etc.) — the BE-gap helpers (_expire_holds, _notify_waitlist) should be moved to a dedicated module for maintainability.
be_gaps.PUT allows setting los_tiers to []; explicit min_nights/pct bounds are not enforced beyond aralık dışı check for scalar pcts — consider validating each tier's pct 0-100 and min_nights>=1.
In reserve-multi the stored 'total_price' equals the pre-discount subtotal (626 for the hold booking) while the UI cart_total is 520; naming/semantics divergence is confusing for downstream reports.
